patch.summary:
Choose Meltwater only if your buying job matches “Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (St” rather than WhatConverts's shape. Choose WhatConverts only if your buying job matches “Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo ” rather than Meltwater's shape. Workflow advantage: Meltwater leans brand-monitoring; WhatConverts leans lead-generation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Meltwater is Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (Starter/Pro/Enterprise/Agency).; WhatConverts is Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo with Plus/Pro/Elite ladders..
- Company-size focus: Meltwater (mid-market, enterprise) vs WhatConverts (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Meltwater-leaning brand-monitoring vs WhatConverts-leaning lead-generation.
- Researched limits: Meltwater — Opaque custom pricing only; WhatConverts — Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Meltwater: Opaque custom pricing only; Not a social scheduler or publishing suite; WhatConverts: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite; Usage overages can dominate TCO.
